title: 27 - Luke Returns
summary: At [[location:delta-eridani]], [[character:bob-replicant]] watches the [[species:delta-eridani-natives|Deltan]] village through a real-time [[technology:vr|VR]], six years after being expelled from Camelot, and sees his tent design catch on. [[character:luke]] drops into the VR from [[location:kappa-ceti]], where [[character:spike]] sniffs at him, and reports a 3 g super-Earth teeming with life and a new batch of Bobs. [[character:archimedes]] and his son [[character:buster]] return from hunting with bows, and Bob says [[character:marvin]] keeps in touch while [[character:bender]] has gone silent.

introducing.name: Buster
introducing.description: A Deltan of [[location:delta-eridani-4|Eden]] and the son of [[character:archimedes]]. As a teased cub he was the cover for his father's first arrows, which Archimedes passed off as small spears for him.
introducing.current_state: Almost as tall as his father and still growing, he now hunts with bow, quiver and arrows alongside him and brings back small game.

updates.current_state: At [[location:delta-eridani]], he watches the Deltan village through a real-time [[technology:vr|VR]] fed by hidden cameras and camouflaged drones, much improved over six years of exile. [[character:marvin]] keeps in touch, but he has heard nothing from [[character:bender]] and has sent one of his clones along Bender's flight plan.

At [[location:kappa-ceti]], he has found a super-Earth with a full ecosystem and gravity just over 3 g, unfit for colonization, and is cataloguing its life. He has started another batch of Bobs and, after Bill's surprise [[technology:vr|VR]] visit, visits [[character:bob-replicant]] the same way, meaning to look up [[character:marvin]].

Now in full adulthood and no longer bookish, he has finally taken up [[character:bob-replicant]]'s tent design, which about half a dozen other couples have copied. He hunts with bow and quiver alongside his son [[character:buster]], bringing back small game.
Out of contact with [[character:bob-replicant]] for reasons unknown. One of Bob's clones is following his flight plan and should report within a year or two.
